records.body: {"commit": "3e63ee3", "archive": "autosourcarr-0.5.0-phase-1.zip", "archive_sha256": "ac322f38af5eb4e0f0110c11ef9afb237624df5aefa955b96598e5ecf22700e7", "built": ["config.json + config.key (AES-256-GCM, key name as associated data), atomic owner-only writes, refusals for newer/damaged/plaintext-secret files", "one-time autosourcarr.env/source-host.env conversion: env files kept, byte-identical backup, verification, persisted report and a notice in Settings", "SettingsSchema (SET-7): Definitions + setup-fields.json + settings-schema.json; generates docs/settings.md, settings page groups, validation, change list", "SettingsEditor: the only writer of config.json; 0.4.x wizard rules and combination checks; transaction id; revision; managed_keys", "/api/v1: settings GET/PUT, schema, conversion, update-notice, setup (GET, finish, reader-preflight, restart), config, storage/database, status/stats, health, diagnostics/metrics, openapi.json", "generated UI client (scripts/generate-api-client.mjs) with CI drift check; setup wizard and Settings page use it", "UpdateNotices (ARC-7), ReaderConfigCheck, CatalogueStatusStats, RuntimeMetrics, KnownPatterns [GeneratedRegex], NuGet lock files + locked restore"], "precedence": "built-in default < config.json < Compose variable < value saved in the app (managed_keys); Compose-only: SETTINGS_CONFIG_DIR, DATA_DIR, DATABASE_DIR, APP_SERVICES_MODE, SOURCE_ENGINE_MODE/UID/GID", "requirements": {"ARC-5": "done (examples/docker-compose.0.5.0.yml, docs/settings.md)", "ARC-6": "done", "ARC-7": "done", "SET-5": "partial: location via Compose; move in phase 2", "SET-7": "done", "CON-5": "done (Connections menu itself is phase 7)"}}

records.title: Values saved in the app win over Compose variables; Compose decides the rest
records.body: {"why": "after conversion a leftover env_file would otherwise undo every Settings change (0.4.x protected wizard values the same way)", "reset": "Use default on the Settings page removes the saved value and hands the setting back to Compose", "compose_only": "folders and identities can only be set in Compose so a wrong value cannot stop the app from starting"}

records.title: Independent audit of phases 0 and 1 found gaps; fixed before closing phase 1
records.body: {"fixed": ["wizard repositories now written to source-host.env while it exists", "leftover env_file no longer overrides app-saved settings", "startup prints the settings key when a saved value is invalid", "conversion leaves a persistent notice", "TZ no longer shows as overridden (environment snapshot before the app sets TZ)", "DATABASE_DIR and other folder/identity settings are Compose-only", "Settings page can reset to default and remove a secret", "conversion test has hand-written expectations", "/api/v1/health added; dependency checks report checked=false", "all config.json secrets registered for redaction"]}
